title: Defenders #106 Marvel 1982 War to End All Wars Death of Nighthawk Bronze Age
conditionDescription: Bright and clean with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. Coupon intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Defenders #106 (April 1982), Marvel Comics - "The War to End All Wars!" Death of Nighthawk. Captain America, Valkyrie, Hellcat, Beast, Daredevil and Doctor Strange; Al Milgrom cover. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Gabriel Lone Ranger Western Town mail-in offer ad (coupon intact).

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
